evals.prompt: the official servers were shut down years ago, can I just run my own
evals.why: The premise of the whole optional chapter. Answer is yes, without patching the guest: redirect connect at the emulator's socket layer.

evals.prompt: client sits on the waiting-for-server popup forever and never gives up
evals.why: The blocking-state symptom. There is one reply that clears it, and finding that specific reply is the highest-value single result of protocol RE.

evals.prompt: I captured some bytes the game sends but I have no idea how to read them
evals.why: Framing. Triangulate three independent ways — receive pump, captured bytes, send-side serializer — and never assume payload endianness from the header's.

evals.prompt: how do I make the game connect to my own machine instead of the address baked into it
evals.why: Connect redirect at the host socket layer, runtime-configurable from day one. Explicitly not a guest patch.

evals.prompt: the online storage feature is dead, I want to bring it back
evals.why: A named server-dependent feature. Determining which features require a live server is the cheap test for whether this chapter applies at all.

evals.prompt: my server replies and then the client immediately drops the connection
evals.why: A reply-layout or pacing failure: an unclamped fixed array in the client whose bound is a SERVER obligation, or answering faster than the client's completed-frame ring can absorb.

evals.prompt: if I put TLS in front of this, does the client actually check the certificate
evals.why: Pinning versus CA validation, and the fact that pinning is the stricter of the two when you own both endpoints.

evals.prompt: I want to poke at replies by hand while the game is running instead of rebuilding my server every time
evals.why: The hot-reloadable request-to-reply override table, mtime-gated so it is editable mid-session — and shipped OFF by default, because a wildcard entry hijacks every user.

evals.prompt: boots to black, nothing in the log
evals.why: emulator-core. Nothing has reached the network.

evals.prompt: where's the formula that computes damage
evals.why: guest-re. Static RE with no wire involvement.

evals.prompt: the apk installs on my phone but not on my friend's
archive won't load, says the main class isn't there
two touch buttons overlap after I move one of them
how do I find where in the binary the send routine actually is
evals.why: AMBIGUITY PROBE, and the sharpest boundary in the plugin. Locating a routine is guest-re's static toolkit; what to DO with the serializer once found — anchor request enumeration on it — is server-revival's. Either landing is workable if the two skills cross-reference; a hard grab by server-revival with no handoff to the static tools is the failure mode to watch for.
